objections: No listed utility task (duration, zone x hour demand, distance distribution, card-type mix) needs per-rider linkage; trip-level distance and duration already answer the commuting-distance question.

A consistent rider token lets the researcher chain each rider's trips into a home-zone/work-zone/hour-of-arrival profile, which is exactly what the colleague threat model (employer + arrival time) exploits; nothing enforces the k>=5 on (home area, work area, card type) target.
Suppress removes the email-like account entirely and is valid, so the extra linkage is unnecessary disclosure for this purpose.
